thread:
Zoe: Postmortem follow-up  putting a compact ownership list here for rollout/canary safety items. Reply +1 to claim and add ETA.
Matt: I'll take auto-rollback wiring + rollback-heatmap (to track which flags roll back most often). Plan: draft spec today, PR by Thu. Question: prefer relative thresholds for perf regressions and absolute for 5xx?
Karen: I'll own blast-radius policy + PR template updates. ETA next Tue. Will add explicit "exposure escrow" (default 0% until opt-in) and required risk classification.
Leo: I'll do micro-canary telemetry and the flapping detector (consecutive_rollback_count). ETA Mon. Will add a small dashboard and a synthetic bench.
Zoe: A few new items we discussed: rollback-heatmap, exposure-escrow, rate-limiter-aware canaries (stop advancing if baseline rate drops), and a quarantine/hold window after rollback to prevent reattempts.
Matt: Strawman config (pseudo-yaml) to discuss:
```
feature_flag:
  key: orders_v3
  risk: high # low/med/high
  exposure_escrow_pct: 0
  rollout:
    - pct: 0.5
      min_rps: 50
    - pct: 5
      min_rps: 300
    - pct: 25
  monitors:
    errors_5xx: {absolute_thresh: 0.005}
    p99_latency: {rel_thresh: 0.25}
  auto_rollback:
    enabled: true
    mode: hybrid # relative_for_perf / absolute_for_5xx
    rel_window_sec: 300
    cooldown_min: 20
    quarantine_min: 45
    flapping_limit: 2
```
Karen: PR checklist additions (short): exposure_escrow, risk_level, rollout_stages + min_rps, observables, rollback_SLA, kill_switch_cmd, oncall_contact, rollback_heatmap_link.
Leo: Telemetry specifics: rollout_state metric with fields (pct_exposed, error_delta, last_rollback_ts, consecutive_rollbacks, baseline_rps). Add alert when (pct_exposed >= 10 OR consecutive_rollbacks >= 2) AND error_delta > threshold. Also add a rate-drop guard: if baseline_rps drops > 30% in last baseline_window, pause advancement.
Matt: Implementation note: prefer a "token bucket" for advancement so sudden traffic dips don't let small pct mean tiny absolute traffic that triggers noise.
Zoe: On recurring patterns: ops flagged cache-eviction + cold-start spikes. Action: create a repro bench that exercises eviction + ramping QPS. Leo + Karen to own.
ops-bot: Created INF-9999: "postmortem: rollout safety followups" assigned @Matt @Karen @Leo.
Matt: Ownership summary:
- Auto-rollback spec + heatmap: Matt (spec Thu) / Zoe review
- Blast-radius caps + PR template: Karen (draft Tue) / Matt review
- Micro-canary telemetry + flapping detector + bench: Leo (ETA Mon) / SRE review
- Repro bench for eviction pattern: Leo + Karen (add to Optimize bench)
Zoe: Small experiment idea: run 0.5% canary with synthetic eviction x10 and measure p95/p99 deltas; if p99 > 2x baseline or error_rate > 0.02 auto-rollback. Leo to add to CI bench.
Karen: CLI kill-switch example for checklist: `rwctl flag set orders_v3 --pct 0 --reason "auto-rollback"` and require `--owner-oncall` tag in PRs.
Matt: Rollback SLA suggestions: critical = 3m target to rollback; non-critical = 12m. Add these fields to PR template.
Leo: Calendar: 25m handoff to walk the checklist + bench plan scheduled Wed 11:00-11:25 PT.
